title: When Hell Meets the Healing Balm of God's Presence
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a deeply personal and vulnerable account of spiritual breakthrough and healing, revealing the tangible presence of God that swept into his home during a season of great need. You'll be inspired by the miraculous ways God intervened in the lives of Pastor Chris and his family, and encouraged to trust in His goodness and faithfulness, no matter what challenges you're facing. Join us as we explore the life-changing encounter that forever altered their journey with God.
